blocks.goal: Reduce the public API and implementation size of ClassMemberInfo by extracting its cohesive annotation-query facade into a dedicated class while preserving the existing annotation metadata behavior.

ops.details: Extract the annotation-query methods getAllAnnotationInfo(), getDirectAnnotationInfo(), getAllAnnotationInfo(Class<? extends Annotation>), getAllAnnotationInfo(String), getDirectAnnotationInfo(Class<? extends Annotation>), getDirectAnnotationInfo(String), getAllAnnotationInfoRepeatable(Class<? extends Annotation>), getAllAnnotationInfoRepeatable(String), getDirectAnnotationInfoRepeatable(Class<? extends Annotation>), getDirectAnnotationInfoRepeatable(String), hasAnnotation(Class<? extends Annotation>), and hasAnnotation(String), together with the required annotationInfoMetadata dependency. Keep ClassMemberInfo delegating these public operations to the extracted class so existing callers remain compatible.
